selection_reason: Owner deferred CCTI-12-T04 until September 2026 and restored the previously approved productive route-around. VCH and POST-GATX-SUCCESSOR were complete, so the next dependency-ordered design operation was APW-01.
objective: Canonicalize universal-user, account, context, contextual-role, GM/Campaign authority, Personal-context authority, and related terminology so later asynchronous play, persistent workspace, APM, and CSW designs cannot inherit ambiguous global GM/Player assumptions.
design_findings: Existing Stage A architecture already separates stable subject identity from current role and separates membership, role, Character control, ownership and entitlement.
Existing Campaign authorization is Campaign-scoped and does not require a global GM/Player account model.
Existing owner-admin separation is preserved: application operational authority does not become Campaign-private authority.
Current A3 activeRole and player/gm dashboard types are valid bounded Stage-A projections, not permanent account identity.
Personal context is defined as independent user workspace authority and Campaign roles have no authority over another user's Personal resources.
Live/asynchronous/hybrid cadence and connected/offline/recovering connectivity are orthogonal to authority context.
Ten additive implementation touch points are identified without authorizing implementation or reopening Stage A closures.
